=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:198-209 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The paginated PR file-list loop makes up to 30 file-list GETs for 3000 files. Together with the two compare GETs that is up to 32 extra requests, against the task's "at most 3 extra GETs" budget.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated it MAJOR because it exceeds the stated API budget and adds shared rate-limit pressure on the stale path. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash cite the same code site but treat the code as a defensible reading of a self-contradictory issue and report only the docs as wrong (NIT).
- README.md:167 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` row says "Costs up to 3 extra reads (the file listing at 100 per page), only on that stale path". The real count is 2 + ceil(changed_files/100), which is up to 32.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but an operator who sizes the API budget from the README undercounts the stale path by about 10x for large PRs. All three reviewers rated it NIT.
- changelog.d/9688-final-ci-sync-only-merge-ref.md:11 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The table row "Extra GitHub reads | up to 3 (the file listing at 100 per page), only on the stale path" understates the paginated read count (up to 30 file-list GETs plus 2 compares).
  WHY: A consumer who sizes API quota from the changelog under-budgets by about 10x in the worst case. All three reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:342 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The default-on `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` kill switch is read only from the step env. No "Verify the final-CI merge ref is current" step in .github/workflows/ci.yml maps it from `vars.*`, so setting the repository variable has no effect.
  WHY: The only rollback an operator can reach is `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED=false`, which also removes the stale protection. Turning off only the new path needs a code change that must itself pass final CI. Both rated it NIT; ci.yml is outside files_touched. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and openai_gpt-6-luna raised the same wiring issue as a task gap (see below).
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:203-204, 216-219, 282-285, 321-324 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The overlap check fetches the PR's live file list but does not bind it to the tested head SHA and does not recheck the head after the fetch.
  WHY: If the PR head moves after line 321-324 and keeps the same file count, the overlap check runs against the new head's files and can accept a merge whose stale base overlaps the tested head. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same race only as a hardening suggestion, not as a finding.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:317-319, 345-348 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When the latest base-tip lookup fails or returns an invalid SHA, the sync-only check falls back to the last valid tip in seen_tips instead of failing closed.
  WHY: The base can have advanced past that earlier tip, so the compare checks an older range and can accept without checking the newer base commits. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked `sync_last_tip`/`seen_tips` and judged it correct.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A switch controls this (CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED, on by default)."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, in each "Verify the final-CI merge ref is current" step's environment
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow steps map CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED but not CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED, so the script defaults to true in Actions and an operator cannot control the switch. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it BLOCKER and openai_gpt-6-luna MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected it as a gap: ci.yml is outside the Files list, the issue says "Entry point: unchanged", and "parsed like" refers to parsing semantics.
- requirement: "API budget (§15), documented in the script header: at most 3 extra GETs, only on the stale path, and none on the fresh path."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only file-listing loop (lines 198-209)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The paginated loop makes one GET per 100 files for up to 3000 files, so up to 30 GETs for the file list plus 2 compare GETs. That far exceeds the 3-GET budget. Rated MAJOR.
- requirement: "API budget (§15), documented in the script header: at most 3 extra GETs, only on the stale path, and none on the fresh path."
  expected_change_site: README.md env var row for `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED`; the "Extra GitHub reads" row in `changelog.d/9688-final-ci-sync-only-merge-ref.md`
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The script header (`scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:66-75`) and the code are consistent (2 compares plus up to 30 file-listing GETs). The README row at line 167 and the changelog table row both say "up to 3" without the pagination caveat. The issue contradicts itself, so this is a documentation fix. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md:167 (the `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` row) and changelog.d/9688-final-ci-sync-only-merge-ref.md:11 ("Extra GitHub reads | up to 3 (the file listing at 100 per page)"); code at scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:199-209 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stale path makes 2 + ceil(changed_files/100) GETs: 4 for 150 files, up to 32 for 3000. The README row ("Costs up to 3 extra reads") and the changelog ("up to 3") read as a hard limit of 3. The script header at lines 70-75 is correct. The issue contradicts itself (item 4 vs item 1).
  WHY: Nothing fails; operators undercount by up to 10x, across 10 final-CI jobs. Fix: "2 compare reads plus 1 per 100 PR files (at most 32), only on the stale path".
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:342 (`sync_switch="$(printf '%s' "${CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED:-true}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new acceptance path is on by default and loosens a fail-closed guard. Its kill switch comes only from the step env, and ci.yml maps only `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED` (asserted at tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py:243). A repo variable therefore has no effect.
  WHY: The only rollback an operator can reach also removes the stale protection. Follow-up, needing a ci.yml scope grant: add `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED: ${{ vars.CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED || 'true' }}` to the 10 check steps.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. All deliverables were verified present. The ci.yml wiring and "at most 3 extra GETs" were explicitly not treated as gaps; both are reported above as NITs.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh: ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only, after the PR file-list loop (around line 209) | hardening suggestion
  PROBLEM: `pulls/<n>/files` returns the live PR's files. If the head moves after the last head_moved check with the same file count, the accept decision rests on the wrong file set.
  WHY: Suggested fix: read `ci_final_merge_ref_pull '.head.sha'` and `sync_reject api_error` unless it equals "${GITHUB_SHA}" (1 extra GET, stale path only; 2 lines).
- README.md:167 / changelog.d/9688-final-ci-sync-only-merge-ref.md line 11 | hardening suggestion
  PROBLEM: Both understate the read count for PRs with more than 100 files.
  WHY: Reword to "2 compare reads plus 1 per 100 PR files (at most 32), stale path only". HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
